Jack Heart, 2026-11-13, on question 3 (whether the machine keeps the previous save locally): "i dont think it should need to save if its confirmed published online, but i also think we can have some grace in our cleanups". So: a local save does not need to be kept once its upload is confirmed; before that confirmation it is the only copy and must stay. Cleanup may have grace, local and remote: it need not be immediate or exact, and something lingering briefly is acceptable. This corrects my earlier steer, which read his previous answer as "keep the previous save on the machine as a fallback"; he did not say that. Not decided by him: how long the grace is, or what counts as confirmed (I would take the pointer naming that save being acknowledged by storage).
